static_traits.name: Mei Li
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends, but not yet talking about one's boredom and Sense of frustration with them; relationships with colleagues tending toward tension from Work negativity and lost motivation
static_traits.medical_history: No similar problem history; no prior psychotherapy; No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear logic, concrete expression; overall negative and doubtful tone, but fairly cooperative; able to Reflect and accept suggestions; negating-the-positive, mental filtering, and Black-and-white cognitive tendencies

basic_info.main_problem: Although the library Work is quiet and pays well, it is extremely boring, sometimes making me about to collapse; this persistent dissatisfaction and boredom appear daily, especially during quiet library periods, affecting Work motivation and overall life satisfaction.
basic_info.core_demands: I realize the persistent dissatisfaction and boredom at Work are affecting my mental health and overall life satisfaction, which prompts me to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: A boring Work equals wasting one's life
Only work full of stimulation and a sense of achievement has value

special_situations.event: During quiet hours at the library, when tasks are few
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If Work is not constantly exciting or busy, then it is meaningless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeking hobbies outside Work to offset boredom; reducing investment at Work, distancing from colleagues to lower disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Nothing is happening; I am wasting time again.

special_situations.event: Thinks about going to work the next day, associating the daily routine as highly repetitive
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If every day is the same, then this Work is doomed not worth continuing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowering Work initiative and expectations, reducing contact with colleagues for Self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Every day is exactly the same; going is just continuing to be tormented.

special_situations.event: After brief positive moments at work (e.g. helping readers and receiving thanks), quickly returns to idle periods
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Brief good moments do not count and cannot change the overall boring nature
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Quickly negating the importance of positive experiences, avoiding attempts to create similar situations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is just a coincidence; it does not mean this Work is meaningful.

special_situations.event: Comparison between the 'ideal job' and the real job and self-expectations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Work should constantly bring excitement and satisfaction, otherwise it is not worth doing
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Scrutinizing Work with high standards, frequent comparison with ideal expectations, thus reinforcing dissatisfaction and reducing investment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Work should make me feel excited and fulfilled; that is how it should be.

core_conflict.wish: Longs to feel meaningful at work, to be needed, and to gain achievement and recognition
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being trapped long-term by monotony and meaninglessness, giving effort but gaining no sense of value
defense_goal: Reducing disappointment and Anxiety through emotional detachment and lowered investment
Negating positive fragments with rational reasons, maintaining the belief that the environment is 'unchangeable' to gain a sense of control

object_relations.self_representation: A worker trapped in a monotonous environment, powerless to change
object_relations.object_representation: A work environment / others that are cold, hard to change, and lacking rewards

object_relations.self_representation: A person not understood, needing to restrain emotions
object_relations.object_representation: Others (friends) who may not understand me and may be 'burdened' by me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes positive segments at work or suggests restructuring views
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding positive fragments as the message 'too trivial to change the overall monotony', worrying about being demanded to be 'optimistic' while reality is ignored
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Listing reasons 'why it will not work' (e.g. 'this is just a coincidence') in a calm but negating tone, using absolutist statements, downplaying positive meaning.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to communicate with friends and seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will not understand oneself and will be burdened by oneself (attributing internal concerns to others' attitudes)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a hesitant, reserved way, emphasizing 'they will not understand / do not want to trouble others', avoiding further discussion of available support.

manifestations: Work quiet and well-paid, but subjectively 'extremely boring, like wasting time'
During quiet periods, feels day after day is the same; finds it hard to gain value and satisfaction from work
Negating brief positive moments ('this is just a coincidence')
outcomes: Low mood and dread/boredom about going to work
Relationship estrangement and tension with colleagues

manifestations: Self-describing as 'trapped in an endless boredom loop'
Doubts whether oneself can influence and change the work experience
outcomes: Avoiding active participation and trying to change

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing friends 'will not understand', hence not seeking support
Externalizes inner concerns, reducing the possibility of trying to connect

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'. Language manifestations include: 'Forget it, I will just endure it', 'I should not trouble others', and so on
manifestations: Not wanting to 'trouble others', pressing the urge to seek support back onto oneself
Reduces initiative and engagement at work to lessen disappointment

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Holds the rigid expectation that 'work should be continuously exciting and fulfilling'
Judges real work by idealized standards, hard to accept gray experiences

exception_events.target_problem: During the library's quiet, repetitive periods, the client usually feels strong boredom and dissatisfaction, believing time is being wasted, thus losing motivation and distancing from colleagues.
exception_events.unique_outcome: Last week once, she helped a Student find a rare book needed for research and received sincere thanks; in the moment felt 'making a difference, being needed', mood clearly improved and Work meaning experienced.
exception_events.reason: Clues: different context (a concrete, important reader need arose); different actions (actively investing in searching and serving); different relationship (gained the other's positive feedback and thanks), hence that experience diverged from past powerlessness and boredom.

positive_force: Has professional information-retrieval and service abilities, gains a sense of achievement when helping others
The work environment is stable with sufficient resources, with space for creative projects and activities
Aware of the problem's impact on body and mind and proactively seeks counseling
Willing to try to more proactively look for projects or opportunities to serve others
Having a few dependable friend resources (potential support not yet utilized)
negative_force: Negating the positive, mental filtering, and black-and-white cognitive biases reinforcing the dissatisfaction experience
The rigid expectation that 'ideally it should be continuously exciting' leads to devaluing reality
Reducing investment and Social withdrawal at Work, decreasing chances of positive feedback
Skeptical attitude toward change, anticipating 'it will be useless anyway'
Work pace is monotonous with long quiet periods, objectively reducing immediate feedback

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent boredom and dissatisfaction at Work, with Decreased drive, distancing from colleagues and negative investment
antecedent: Quiet periods at the library, few tasks
Repetitive processes and lack of immediate feedback
As work time approaches or when thinking 'every day is the same'
target_behavior.core_reason: High expectations of Work meaning plus cognitive biases (mental filtering, negating the positive, black-and-white) making reward feel insufficient, reinforcing the interpretive frame 'boredom = meaninglessness'.
target_behavior.function: Escaping discomfort emotions like boredom and disappointment, lowering investment for Self-protection and saving mental energy
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected, Tense relationships with colleagues, overall mood and daily Decreased motivation, further solidifying negative experience
